title: Grandes civilizaciones
goal: Read about the Maya and Inca in real depth, and talk about what made each distinctive.
grammar: Se pasiva / impersonal, y voz pasiva

items: Explain who the Maya and Inca were, and roughly where each flourished.
Name specific features of the Maya and Inca, such as Maya city-states and Inca quipus and chasqui relays.
Describe one thing historians still debate about these societies.
Describe how Inca administrators recorded censuses and tribute.
Use se pasiva/impersonal and voz pasiva to talk about historical events.
